instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\fixture_complex.step. Create a fixture-aware milling setup. Register all four fixture blocks from the STEP model, machine the central island pocket and outside contour, and maintain at least 4 mm clearance from every fixture whenever toolpath Z is below 20 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is the roughing end mill and T2 is the finishing end mill; both must respect the 4 mm fixture clearance rule. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-17.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
